mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0') AS clueTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('0','1','2','3')) AS clueProcessing, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '4') AS clueDone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status NOT IN ('4','5') AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < CURDATE()) AS clueOverdue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_person WHERE del_flag = '0') AS personTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_report_record WHERE del_flag = '0') AS reportTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_kb_document WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '已入库') AS kbDocTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_kb_chunk WHERE del_flag = '0') AS kbChunkTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_conflict_declare WHERE del_flag = '0') AS conflictTotal

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, c.status) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue c LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_clue_status' AND d.dict_value = c.status WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.status, d.dict_label ORDER BY c.status

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, c.source_type) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue c LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_clue_source' AND d.dict_value = c.source_type WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.source_type, d.dict_label ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, c.violation_type) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue c LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_violation_type' AND d.dict_value = c.violation_type WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.violation_type, d.dict_label ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT COALESCE(cat.cat_name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_kb_document d LEFT JOIN jc_kb_category cat ON cat.category_id = d.category_id WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '已入库' GROUP BY d.category_id, cat.cat_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_report_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
